execution: Alternate sparse then short16 for groups 01 through 05. Independently pair each exact Mesh arm with that guest's stock Oban arm.
retry: Keep every attempt. Retry a failed setup under the same group, order and canonical settings, up to three attempts. Valid measured gate misses are included on the first successful boot.
workload: Original sparse and short16 canonical profiles with three-second idle, two vCPUs and 2 GiB, PostgreSQL 17.11 and physical caps 5 and 20, compiled named effects, scoped TLS, pinned inetrc and stock flags.
